  %dim3 = stablehlo.constant dense<3> : tensor<i64>
  %dims2 = stablehlo.constant dense<[2]> : tensor<1xi64>
  %dims3 = stablehlo.constant dense<[3]> : tensor<1xi64>
  %rev_kh = "stablehlo.reverse"(%arg0) {dimensions = %dims2} : (tensor<6x6x3x7xf32>) -> tensor<6x6x3x7xf32>
  %rev_kh_kw = "stablehlo.reverse"(%rev_kh) {dimensions = %dims3} : (tensor<6x6x3x7xf32>) -> tensor<6x6x3x7xf32>

  // Transpose kernel dims 0 and 1 to swap in/out channels
  %perm = stablehlo.constant dense<[1, 0, 2, 3]> : tensor<4xi64>
  %kernel_transposed = "stablehlo.transpose"(%rev_kh_kw) {permutation = %perm} : (tensor<6x6x3x7xf32>) -> tensor<6x6x3x7xf32>

  %padding = stablehlo.constant dense<[[0, 0], [0, 0]]> : tensor<2x2xi64>
  %lhs_dilation = stablehlo.constant dense<[1, 1]> : tensor<2xi64>
  %rhs_dilation = stablehlo.constant dense<[1, 1]> : tensor<2xi64>

  %result = "stablehlo.convolution"(%arg1, %kernel_transposed) {

  } : (tensor<8x6x7x7xf32>, tensor<6x6x3x7xf32>) -> tensor<8x6x9x13xf32>

  return %result : tensor<8x6x9x13xf32>
}
